versions.changelog:
No changes were detected in this release.  
- Version updated to 1.0.1, but file contents remain unchanged.

Initial release of dependency-impact-analyzer.

- Analyze upgrade, removal, or replacement impact for any dependency.
- Trace all imports/usages across JS/TS, Python, and Go codebases.
- Assess test coverage of affected files and highlight untested risky areas.
- Detect potential breaking API changes by analyzing version differences and deprecation status.
- Generate safe upgrade plans and suggest migration strategies, including mapping APIs when replacing dependencies.
- Audit overall dependency risk and highlight deprecated or high-risk packages.
